question_en: Make the scan refocus at every point: 3x3 at 0.01 mm spacing, 3% power, 0.5 second exposure, from the current stage position. Preview first, then run it.
setup: Place the sample near focus: if the guide-beam spot is not detected, autofocus fails with _AF_UNMEASURED_ABORT.
overlap: Differs from C16 only in the autofocus argument ('each' vs 'center').
